rule: The verified allowance is 20 Figma MCP tool calls per calendar month for a Full seat on the Starter tier
rationale: Verified 2026-09-06 from the provider resource file://figma/docs/rate-limits-access.md and corroborated by the provider's own upgrade-remediation text

rule: Assume every Figma MCP call is metered unless the provider explicitly names the tool as exempt
rationale: The provider's general statement that write tools are exempt does not agree in scope with its enumerated list of only three exempt tools so exemption is NOT ASSERTED

rule: The three tools documented as exempt are add_code_connect_map create_new_file and whoami and only these may be treated as free
rationale: Narrow reading is the safe reading because an over-broad exemption assumption is discovered only by exhausting the month

rule: Every Figma MCP call is recorded in mcp-call-ledger.csv before the next call is made
rationale: A budget that is not counted is not a budget and the provider exposes no readable counter to reconcile against
enforcement: producer discipline plus B01 exit report

rule: The ledger records call sequence date tool name batch id purpose and whether a rate-limit response was returned
rationale: Rate-limit responses are the only empirical signal of which tools are actually metered

rule: FOUNDER DECISION 2026-09-06 — all 20 monthly calls are spendable with zero reserve, and every individual call requires explicit founder approval immediately before it is made
rationale: The founder holds the reserve decision directly rather than delegating it to a fixed number; per-call approval makes a standing reserve redundant because no call is ever made without a live decision
enforcement: founder decision recorded in this row

rule: The producer never makes a Figma MCP call unprompted and stops and requests approval for each one stating the tool the purpose and the running count consumed this month
rationale: Per-call approval is only meaningful if the founder can see the remaining allowance at the moment of each decision

rule: B01 runs first and doubles as the metering experiment that measures true per-batch cost
rationale: B01 is already the gated pilot under MA-025 item 5 so measuring there costs nothing extra and is the cheapest place to be wrong

rule: No schedule for B02 B03 B04 B05 B06 or B08 may be stated until B01 reports a measured per-batch projection
rationale: Projecting from an unmeasured assumption is the precise failure mode that section 7.2 was written to prevent

rule: Mandatory non-evidence overhead is three calls per batch being one EC-25 inventory read one EC-28 _PRE archive export and one EC-29 _EXIT archive export
rationale: This 21-call floor across seven batches already exceeds one month's allowance and is why the programme spans multiple months

rule: No call may be made to work around the allowance by a second account a second seat or a trial
rationale: Zero spend and single editor are MA-025 conditions and circumventing an allowance is a contract breach not an optimisation

rule: No purchase upgrade or paid prompt may be accepted to restore allowance
rationale: SC-05 routes a blocked limit to MA-010 for founder decision and never to a purchase

rule: Prefer one broad read over several narrow reads where the contract permits it and batch evidence capture to the coarsest granularity that still satisfies EC-01 through EC-06
rationale: Under a 20-call month call count matters more than call size and the contract constrains evidence content not read granularity

rule: A failed or malformed call still counts against the allowance and is recorded in the ledger as consumed
rationale: Assuming failures are refunded would silently overspend the month

rule: Exhausting the allowance halts the batch and is reported and is never treated as a failure to route around
rationale: A stop is a normal expected outcome under the contract's stop-condition model
